summary: Verified fix for 'usuario' role: Entrada Rápida now works (POST /api/inventario/entrada -> 200) and min/max existence fields are editable (PUT /api/inventario/productos/{id} -> 200). Price update by usuario correctly rejected (400). No admin regression. All backend tests (5/5) pass and E2E flow confirmed via Playwright with network capture showing 200 responses.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/inventario.py: whitelist approach for 'usuario' PUT is correct; ensure any future writable field for usuario is added explicitly.
Frontend 'puedeEditarExistencias' flag on Productos.js line ~29 correctly enables min/max inputs for usuario role.
seed_data_creation: None. Only registered small stock entries (+2, +1) using existing product Estuche para Lentes de Contacto (PROD-00014).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_inventario_usuario_permisos.py cover: usuario can update min/max, usuario cannot change precio_venta (400), usuario/admin can register entrada. Note: entrada endpoint requires costo_unitario, and product with controla_lotes=true requires lote+fecha_vencimiento; tests pick a non-lote product automatically. Frontend routes at /inventario/productos, testids: btn-entrada-{id}, btn-edit-{id}, btn-confirmar-entrada, producto-existencia-minima/maxima.
rca of the issue: Original bug: POST /api/inventario/entrada and PUT /api/inventario/productos permissions blocked role 'usuario' (403), causing button clicks to silently fail. Fix added 'usuario' to permission list with whitelist restricting mutable fields (existencia_minima, existencia_maxima) while keeping precio_venta restricted. Frontend enabled min/max inputs for usuario. All verified working E2E.
